Stage 1 · Attract

A marketing plan you can actually execute

  • Content writing: SEO and GEO articles, blog posts, email
  • Video scripting: hooks, FAQ reels, explainer videos
  • Video generating and editing: cuts, captions, b-roll
  • Website design and development, 100% in AI: ditch WordPress forever
  • Building and deploying high-converting landing pages in AI, ditching page builders
  • Social media marketing: calendar, graphics, publishing
  • Ad campaign launch: Meta, Google, ChatGPT ads for your agency
  • Keyword research and PPC forecasting
Stage 2 · Convert

The one-person sales team

  • Detailed, custom analyses with your methodology trained into the AI
  • Call recordings summarized into the CRM: situation, goals, budget, objections, next steps
  • Proposals built from the call and your template the same day, with their numbers and market
  • Pricing, forecast, and ROI models that show what the engagement pays back
  • Objection handling and follow-up emails drafted in your voice
  • Follow-up sequences that never go quiet, and re-engagement of every old lead
  • Pipeline tracking: stages, notes, proposals attached to every record
Stage 3 · Deliver

Delivery finally scales

  • Client onboarding in an afternoon: access captured, folders built, kickoff deck, project and sprints set up
  • Website quality and local SEO audits that used to take a week, run against live data and written up for the client
  • 12-month project plans and sprints generated from the audit findings, with owners, dates, and deliverables
  • Content and creative production every month: articles, graphics, video edits, landing pages, ads
  • Campaign management across search and social, with changes logged and explained
  • Weekly and monthly client reporting pulled from live ad and analytics data, automatically
  • Client communication in your voice: updates, recaps, next steps, and answers to the hard questions
